intro.text: A city where crime is rare, partly because people fear the nightmares that roam at night.
One of the chief cities of Nagadan, which is the biggest nation on its world.

description.text: Painters are respected but poorly paid, and raises are seldom discussed. The Nightmare Division has its headquarters in the city, where painters report after their shifts and the foreman has his office.

Residents enjoy hion viewer programs and shop at several shopping centres, one of them upmarket and costly. On festivals, rest days and other special occasions a carnival opens, known locally by a name meaning "place of a million lights", with food stalls, games, performers and rides.

The city is round, split into wedges and rings and crossed by asphalt streets wide enough for vehicles. White warehouses without outward windows line its edge just inside a perimeter road, and a neighbouring lake supplies most of its water.

While the shroud stood, it closed over the city like a dome. Fear of nightmares pushed poorer districts toward the edge, where a pleasure district and the narrow Rabble Way market are busiest after dark. Because the shroud was always dark, night was kept by custom.

items.text: Hundreds of stable nightmares were sent against the city. Many of its painters joined a resistance and fought them off, saving Kilahito from destruction. Soon after, the machine fell, the shroud vanished, and the people saw the sun.
